goal.what: Chat interviews; dashboard shows suitable hook options for selection.
goal.successCriteria: Select hooks and carry only those IDs and texts into Video creation.

layout.placement: Chat left with persistent composer; four tabs, 2-by-2 hook grid, selection bar right. Blank left cells reserve ongoing chat.
layout.hierarchy: Chat asks and explains; dashboard shows and selects.

typeSystem.display: Be Vietnam Pro, 32px title, 18px hook text.

colorMaterial.surfaces: White cards, pale sage selected cards.
colorMaterial.signal: Green #346149 for selection, tabs and actions.

copy.headline: Hook suggestion
copy.subtitle: Chọn các hook bạn muốn đưa sang Video creation.

constraints.font: Vietnamese-safe sans-serif; exact stage label Hook suggestion.
constraints.container: No default selection; accessible checkboxes separate from video controls. Four local H264 360x640 clips are 3-second silent animations, clearly marked mock video. Playing a clip must not select its hook. Only one clip plays at a time. Edited hooks keep a Hook gốc label on their original mock clip. Ask interview questions one at a time in chat.

negativePrompt: No analysis paragraphs or editor on dashboard.

directions.name: 02 · Video creation
directions.notes: Three selected hooks become three full-video review cards. Each has Edit in chat and Approve for posting underneath. 30% chat / 70% dashboard. The front end uses labeled storyboard frames until a real rendered video is loaded; it never claims generated assets exist.

goal.what: Review separate full-video versions with different selected hooks.
goal.successCriteria: Inspect each version, edit its hook through chat, approve individually without publishing.

format.safeMargins: 24–35px panels, 14px card gaps; mobile stacks videos.

layout.grid: 3fr / 7fr split; three equal video cards across when space permits.
layout.placement: Chat left; stage tabs, video summary and video cards right. Each card has hook, player, status and its own two actions.
layout.hierarchy: Video versions first; per-card edit and approval below. No global-only actions.

colorMaterial.surfaces: White cards, subdued sage and clay storyboard art.
colorMaterial.signal: Green #346149 for approval and active tab.

copy.headline: Một video. Ba cách mở đầu.
copy.subtitle: Xem từng phiên bản, chỉnh trong chat hoặc duyệt để đăng.

constraints.font: Keep exact English per-card action labels.
constraints.container: Only selected hooks appear; 3 is the example, not a forced count. Stable version IDs match hook IDs. Edit in chat targets that version and accepts a direct text replacement. Editing invalidates its asset and approval. Only playable real video assets can be approved. Approval is reversible and does not publish; browser-loaded videos and approvals reset on reload.

negativePrompt: No fake generated videos or pretending the same source is three renders.

goal.what: Metrics stage, not a scheduling screen.
goal.successCriteria: Review comparable metrics, filter platform and window, expand details.

format.safeMargins: 24–35px panels; table can scroll internally on mobile.

layout.grid: 3fr / 7fr split; three summary cells in the dashboard.
layout.placement: Chat left; tabs, filters, metrics, comparison table and next action right.

typeSystem.contrast: Clear labels and tabular missing values.

copy.headline: Đọc kết quả từng phiên bản.
copy.subtitle: So sánh lượt xem và tỷ lệ xem qua 3 giây trong cùng khoảng thời gian.

constraints.accent: One green signal; text-only platform names.
constraints.container: User-requested mock fixture is explicitly labeled and independent of current hook selections and approvals. Platform and window controls recompute totals, weighted retention and weighted watch time; details use the same source rows. Baseline 24-hour all-platform views: 121900.

negativePrompt: No presenting mock data as live or connected account metrics.
No inconsistent summary and table totals.

directions.name: 04 · Loop results
directions.notes: Explicit mock 72-hour loop results share the same dataset as Metrics. Show H01 as the sample leader, ranked retention bars and example views. Keep actual current-session approvals separate from the mock loop. Notes remain user-authored. 30% chat / 70% dashboard.

goal.what: Loop summary, learning and next hypothesis.
goal.audience: Creators deciding what to test next.
goal.successCriteria: Separate actual data, user-authored learning and next hypothesis.

format.safeMargins: 24–35px panels; note cards stack on mobile.

layout.grid: 3fr / 7fr split; outcome banner and two note cards right.
layout.placement: Chat left; tabs, outcome, counts, notes and history right.
layout.hierarchy: Outcome, learning, next test; never a winner without data.

typeSystem.contrast: Readable textareas and restrained section labels.

colorMaterial.surfaces: Pale sage outcome, white note cards.

copy.headline: Một vòng thử. Một điều học được.
copy.subtitle: Tổng kết các hook và ghi lại hướng thử tiếp theo.

constraints.container: User-requested mock results derive from the same dataset as Metrics at 72 hours. H01 leads by view-weighted 3-second retention, not a fabricated confidence score. Current-session approvals are separate. Preserve user notes and next hypothesis in sessionStorage; never seed over their text.

negativePrompt: No presenting mock results as actual posting outcomes.
No automatic AI diagnosis or confidence claims.
Do not discard current notes or hide chat.
